title: Tissue and Plasma Biomarkers of Lymph Node Involvement in Cervical Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to measure the levels of serum proteins and other biomarkers in cervical cancer patients. We believe that some of these markers may be useful in selecting patients for specific types of cancer therapies. These markers may also help to predict response to therapy, relapse after therapy, and survival after therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must have a known or suspected cervical cancer.
* Age \>=18 years.
* Patients must have no other active cancer at the time of diagnosis.
* Patients must have no history of a hysterectomy.
* Patients must be able to give informed consent.
* Patients must be willing to undergo a biopsy of the cervical tumor to provide tissue for the study.
* Patients must have completed a standard-of-care FDG-PET/CT prior to initiation of therapy, for assessment of lymph nodes.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Pregnant women
study_population: Recruitment of patients for participation in this study will occur at Stanford Medical Center. All facilities are adequately equipped to meet all study requirements. Patients of this disease type are regularly treated at Stanford Cancer Center. Estimated accrual rates are based on normal patient flow.
